title: THE BELLOWS · CHAIN LAPS
vibe: 45 min · green · heart session · FOR TIME · 4 laps, cap 28:00 · reps fall, legs get longer and faster
why: Heart day. Three unbroken chains a lap, each one dumping you straight onto the belt, and the session negative-splits: reps drop every lap while the run legs get longer and faster.

blocks.title: THE BELLOWS · FOR TIME · 4 LAPS
blocks.meta: FOR TIME · 4 LAPS · 3 chains per lap · a run leg out of every chain · cap 28:00 · 2×40 lb
blocks.format: One clock. Chain, leg, chain, leg, chain, leg — that is one lap. Four laps for time. Numbers read lap 1 / 2 / 3 / 4.
blocks.workRest: 12 run legs, 2.1 mi total. Lap 1 · 0.15 mi @ 7.8 · Lap 2 · 0.15 mi @ 8.3 · Lap 3 · 0.20 mi @ 8.8 · Lap 4 · 0.20 mi @ 9.3. No rest — the leg is the rest.

items.name: C1 · Double deadlift → hang power clean → push jerk · 6 / 5 / 4 / 3 each
items.detail: 2×40 lb, unbroken — bells never touch down inside the chain

items.name: C2 · Double high pull · 12 / 10 / 8 / 6
items.detail: straight off the last devil press, unbroken

items.name: C3 · Mountain climber · 24 / 20 / 16 / 12
items.detail: straight to the floor, count both knees

blocks.noteGreen: Finish 4 laps inside 28:00. Log your time, which chain broke first, and RPE.
blocks.text: Devil press: both bells to the floor, chest down, stand and punch them overhead in one motion. Push jerk: quick knee bend, punch up, lock out tall. Thruster: bells in the rack, drive out of the bottom straight overhead.

items.name: Weighted V-up 35 lb ×15
items.detail: bell over the chest, shoulders and heels leave the floor together

items.name: Around the world 35 lb ×10 each direction
items.detail: bell circles the hips, stay tall, no lean

items.name: Hand walkout ×8
items.detail: walk the hands out flat, walk them back
